slides.badge: Growth, decay, half-life — read, don't solve

slides.title: Define p(x), then type p(3)
slides.tip: Desmos prints the value beside it: 800 growing at 50% a year reaches 2,700 in 3 years.

slides.title: "When does it drop below?" is a crossing
slides.tip: Graph the target as a flat line: 1,200 halving each year hits 300 at exactly x = 2.

slides.title: Ask for h(3) and skip the logarithm
slides.tip: 160 falls to exactly 80 in 3 units. Halving questions never need logs on this test.
